comment: The Client ID of your Duo Security application, used for the Duo Universal Prompt.
modal: Identifies the Duo Security application that authenticates admin sign-ins via the Duo Universal Prompt. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel and enter it here.

comment: The Client Secret of your Duo Security application; stored encrypted.
modal: The secret paired with the Duo **Client Id** for the Duo Universal Prompt. It is stored encrypted. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel.

comment: The API hostname of your Duo Security account.
modal: The Duo API hostname (for example the `api-….duosecurity.com` host from your Duo admin panel) that this store contacts for the Duo Universal Prompt.

comment: The integration key of your Duo Security application.
modal: The integration key issued for the Duo application used by the Duo Universal Prompt. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel.

comment: The secret key of your Duo Security application; stored encrypted.
modal: The secret key paired with the Duo **Integration Key**. It is stored encrypted. Obtain it from your Duo admin panel.

comment: The API key of your Authy account, used for Authy two-factor authentication; stored encrypted.
modal: The Authy API key that this store uses to send and verify Authy two-factor challenges. It is stored encrypted. Obtain it from your Authy/Twilio account.

comment: The approval message shown to users in Authy OneTouch push requests.
modal: The text displayed in the Authy OneTouch approval prompt that users receive when signing in. Use it to identify the request.
